phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 180-240 game time, with a heavy economy and expanding. Enemy intelligence is uncertain, with no clear combat units observed, but production and technology appear heavy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck as soon as more enemy information is available.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansion, maintain defense, continue tech, and re-evaluate when enemy intentions become clearer.
phase_policies.target: Focus on economy and expansion while maintaining a defensive posture. Continue developing your technology.
phase_policies.title: Economy and Expansion Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to army production early, which would slow your economy and neglect scouting for early pressure or all-ins.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, around 240-360 game time, with a solid economy and expanding. Enemy intelligence suggests a Terran ground posture with heavy production and technology, possibly with Marines and Reapers.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of air transitions or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground army, maintain expansion and production, and adapt to enemy transitions.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and technology while strengthening your ground army. Maintain your expansion and production.
phase_policies.title: Ground Development and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend against a heavy ground Terran by engaging Siege Tanks head-on without proper tech or positioning, or over-expanding without sufficient army to defend.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, around 420-540 game time, with a heavy economy and production. Enemy intelligence shows a Terran ground posture with Marines and Hellions, indicating potential harassment or early pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent transitions to air or shows signs of a large push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army, continue tech, defend against harassment, and adjust to enemy movements.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your ground army and continue developing your technology. Be prepared to defend against Hellion run-bys or Marine pushes.
phase_policies.title: Defensive Ground and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while teching, or over-expand if an imminent attack is sensed.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, around 600-720 game time, with a heavy economy and production. Enemy intelligence shows a Terran ground posture with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Thors, indicating a strong ground army.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent transitions to heavy air or shows signs of a timing attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground strength, continue economy and tech, prepare anti-air if needed, and monitor for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your ground army strength while continuing to develop your economy and technology. Consider adding more anti-air if the opponent's air presence increases.
phase_policies.title: Ground Strength and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground forces without considering potential air transitions, or neglect anti-air if the opponent adds air units.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
